method: Every price was read from the vendor’s own pricing page with WebFetch on 2026-10-10 and typed in by hand. “input” is standard (non-cached) input, “cached” is the cache-hit / cached-input rate, “output” includes reasoning tokens where the vendor bills them as output. Standard (non-batch, non-priority) rates and the short-context tier are used. Cache-write surcharges, batch and priority modes, data-residency uplifts, search/tool-call fees and regional pricing are not included.
not_verified: Moonshot (Kimi) and other models listed in the older AI Token Calculator were not re-checked and are not included here.
Mistral’s own pricing page (mistral.ai/pricing) only showed consumer plans when fetched; API prices come from docs.mistral.ai/inference/pricing (Mistral’s official docs).
OpenAI’s openai.com/api/pricing page now shows ChatGPT plan pricing, not API prices; API prices come from developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing.
Long-context tiers are listed in each model’s note but not modelled in the maths; the page warns when your per-call context passes a threshold.
